provenance_note: Official response of the National Diet Library's Diet minutes API (JSON, UTF-8), served with Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store; the JSON carries no timestamp, session token or request echo, so it is not generated per request. Researcher (part C): Re-downloaded from the API, the third time with a cache-busting query parameter cb=<epoch> appended; the JSON carries no timestamp, session token or request echo and is served with Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store: 4 downloads at 2026-09-24T21:44:37Z, 2026-09-24T22:13:18Z, 2026-09-24T22:33:00Z, 2026-09-25T00:06:03Z UTC (first and last 141 minutes apart) gave the same byte count and SHA-256. The part C check downloaded it again on 25 September 2026 at 00:09Z-00:14Z (plain), at 00:10Z-00:11Z (the live hosts with a cache-busting query) and at 00:40Z-00:46Z (plain), each time with the same byte count and SHA-256. Downloaded on 25 September 2026 (UTC) by this packet at 01:35:23Z, 01:42:12Z (cache-busting query), 02:16:45Z, each time with the same byte count and SHA-256; at least two downloads were 30 minutes or more apart. Bytes and SHA-256 are of the identity-encoded body, requested without Accept-Encoding (the Diet API and the Internet Archive send gzip when a client asks for it, which changes the transferred bytes but not the content). This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, PDFs, images and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Secretary General of the House of Councillors (岡村隆司) reported that at 09:19 on 10 November 2021, the day the 206th (special) session convened after the general election, the House received from Prime Minister Kishida (岸田内閣総理大臣) the notice that the Cabinet had decided that day to resign en masse.

locator.item: 内閣総辞職に関する報告

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-13 only (stacked on CLAUDE-C01-12). Each House's designation vote, any joint committee and the House of Representatives' prevailing resolution, the Imperial appointment ceremony, Kantei statements and accounts, the Official Gazette's appointment and loss-of-office notices, the Cabinet's minutes, a cabinet's formation, its resignation en masse, any continued performance of duties and acting designations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this role: an unnamed statement or schedule row, a House of Councillors designee who never held the office, or a designation of acting ministers. Ministers, deputy prime ministers and party offices are excluded.
